status: predeclared; clipping calibration and training pending

calibration.statistic: Median L2 update norm over every participation in the complete attack-free pilot runs

clipping: One L2 projection of the complete local model update before release; the zero-noise control is also clipped
noise: Independent Gaussian coordinates with standard deviation sigma times the clipping bound, applied on the client before the reply
aggregation: The unchanged sample-count-weighted FedAvg consumes exactly the same perturbed matrices as every shadow scorer
adjacency: Replace the full data of one registered client, conditional on fixed public client identities, partition assignment and record counts
sensitivity: Twice the clipping bound for each individually visible client release
accountant: Unamplified Gaussian RDP composed over each client's public participation count; also report the conservative bound for participation in every round
randomness: Public coordinate-seeded Gaussian draws for reproducible simulation; analytic bounds describe ideal undisclosed Gaussian randomness, not a deployment guarantee for these public-seeded runs
calibration_privacy: The public-benchmark pilot calibration is outside the accountant. The ideal Gaussian bound assumes the chosen clipping bound and auxiliary metadata are public constants independent of a subsequently protected dataset; choosing a scale on private data requires separate accounting
primary_comparison: Honest false-penalty rate of B1 versus the already-frozen Mstar; Aref isolates the reference component
method_policy: Reuse the published Mstar parameters without tuning to privacy evaluation outcomes
execution_policy: Run the complete comparison on one device after the main evaluation grid; no offline perturbation substituted for Flower training
